meta.title: A vendor cannot read a round's activity log
gaps: read_history reads the event's history, not a round-specific activity log
The plan does not independently assert that the vendor refusal is not a server error
warnings: a plan with only read-backs is judged by its assertions; the expected outcome is treated as accept
verify 2: read_history's reply shape has not been sampled; "code" is unverified

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: As the buyer, read the event's history and check that Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
As the invited QA vendor, read the event's history and check that Data check: “code” equals 536.
words.expected: The app refuses it with “You are not allowed to view this event.”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked); Data check: “code” equals 536.
